items.label: USAO-MA civil: Steward Health Care System LLC and related corporate entities
items.detail: False Claims Act settlement over payments to physicians and practices for services not performed and below-market rents tied to referrals; date is the announcement date. Amount is approximately $4.735 million as stated; the release says Steward admits and accepts responsibility for the underlying facts despite earlier public denials. Amount set 2026-10-11 to the figure the filed Settlement Agreement states ($4,735,779.04, Doc 72-3, paragraph 1); interest at 1.625% from 2021-11-03 and the relators' attorney fees are not counted. | One total paid by entities of this one company: counted once, in full, $4,735,779.04 (data/manual/shared-allocations.csv).
